title: Need help setting up RCCL for AMD MI250X cluster
description: We just acquired a new cluster with 8 nodes, each containing 4 AMD MI250X GPUs. We want to set up RCCL for distributed deep learning workloads but are unsure about the best configuration. Specifically: 1) What RCCL version works best with MI250X? 2) How do we configure NUMA binding for optimal performance? 3) Are there any special environment variables we should set? 4) How does RCCL performance compare to NCCL on equivalent hardware? We're planning to run large language model training with 70B+ parameters. The nodes are connected via 200Gbps Ethernet with RDMA support.
